Steps: Run tests/test_browser_harness.py and tests/test_regression_suite.py; classify CARTO MapLibre errors alongside URL-less TypeError application errors and page errors.
Expected Result: Only failures that identify both a CARTO resource and MapLibre provenance are optional-basemap noise; URL-less fetch TypeErrors application errors and all page errors remain fatal.
Notes: Classifier matrix and regression-suite unit tests pass. The failure-state browser contract uses deterministic CARTO raster responses while the dedicated CDN-blocked contract retains real outage coverage; the focused deployed-candidate failure/recovery run passes. Covers D-262, D-268, and D-270.

Test Name: Web transport failures never expose request URLs or driver coordinates
Preconditions: A web API request fails by HTTP status timeout network error or malformed JSON.
Steps: Run frontend/src/lib/api.test.ts; drive getJSON through HTTP rejection timeout abortion network rejection and malformed JSON using privacy-bearing request/exception text; render the public message contract.
Expected Result: Every branch returns a typed bounded failure and rendered generic reason only; no URL query bbox latitude longitude search term parser detail or upstream body is retained in user-visible state.
Notes: Focused API Vitest passes 7/7 including all four transport branches and the production frontend build succeeds. Covers D-263.
